controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.text: Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and interested parties, and reviewed at planned intervals and when significant changes occur.

controls.title: Threat intelligence
controls.text: Information relating to information security threats shall be collected and analysed to produce threat intelligence.

controls.title: Acceptable use of information and assets
controls.text: Rules for the acceptable use and procedures for handling information and other associated assets shall be identified, documented and implemented.

controls.title: Access control
controls.text: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on business and information security requirements.

controls.title: Authentication information
controls.text: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process, including advising personnel on appropriate handling of authentication information.

controls.title: Information security for use of cloud services
controls.text: Processes for acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services shall be established in accordance with the organization's information security requirements.

controls.title: Information security incident management planning
controls.text: The organization shall plan and prepare for managing information security incidents by defining, establishing and communicating incident management processes, roles and responsibilities.

controls.title: Information security awareness, education and training
controls.text: Personnel and relevant interested parties shall receive appropriate information security awareness, education and training and regular updates of the organization's policies and procedures relevant to their job function.

controls.title: Physical entry
controls.text: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls and access points.

controls.title: Privileged access rights
controls.text: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.

controls.title: Secure authentication
controls.text: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.text: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use shall be obtained, the organization's exposure to such vulnerabilities shall be evaluated and appropriate measures taken.

controls.title: Data leakage prevention
controls.text: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks and any other devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information.

controls.title: Information backup
controls.text: Backup copies of information, software and systems shall be maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed topic-specific policy on backup.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.text: Networks, systems and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.text: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.
